scenes.say: Until fifteen, William Byron raced only on a simulator. Later he won the Daytona five hundred.
NASCAR has several rungs, each with its own minimum age. ARCA from fifteen, the Cup only from eighteen.
It starts with karts, dirt ovals and little Legends cars. Kyle Larson came straight off the dirt.
Next come Late Models at local short tracks. Plenty of drivers stay there for their whole career.
ARCA is where many first race on a superspeedway. Then the Trucks, open from sixteen on short tracks.
The second tier is now the O'Reilly series. Byron won it as a rookie in twenty seventeen, then went Cup racing.
NASCAR calendar and standings are on LapRadar.

title: The road to NASCAR: from dirt ovals to the Cup
